info.title: Salon Booking API
info.description: Single-salon, optional multi-branch booking API. Request components are generated from the same Zod schemas used by Express. Monetary values use integer minor units, timestamps are UTC ISO 8601 values, local calendar dates use YYYY-MM-DD, and business display/scheduling uses the configured IANA time zone.

refreshCookie.name: salon_refresh
refreshCookie.description: HttpOnly refresh cookie. Browser refresh also requires the X-CSRF-Token header.

RequestId.name: X-Request-Id
RequestId.description: Optional caller correlation ID. Invalid values are replaced by a generated UUID.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Required replay-safe operation key. Reusing it with different input returns 409.

CsrfToken.name: X-CSRF-Token
CsrfToken.description: Required only when refreshToken is read from the HttpOnly cookie; copy the readable CSRF cookie/authentication.csrfToken value.

RequestId.description: Correlation ID for logs and support.

RateLimitLimit.description: Maximum requests in the current window.

RateLimitRemaining.description: Requests remaining in the current window.

RateLimitReset.description: Unix timestamp when the current rate-limit window resets.

RetryAfter.description: Seconds before a rate-limited request should be retried.

SetCookie.description: Refresh and CSRF cookies. Browsers must send credentials on later auth requests.

requestId.description: Correlation ID; normally a UUID unless supplied by the client.
